result.summary: Found several visual issues: a critical unlocalized title key, truncated restaurant names, and cut-off category chips and cards indicating layout overflow problems.

issues.description: Section heading shows raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and ensure localization is loaded.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing characters on the right edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width/padding so full names are visible.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. 'Healthy') and the third 'Fastest near you' card are clipped at the screen edge, with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with proper peek/padding or wrap chips so all content is fully visible.

issues.description: Bottom pizza promotional card is partially cut off by the tab bar, hiding part of the image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the tab bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.
